_doc: The UI's look (read by src/view/ui/theme.gd). A direction is the neutral look of menus and the base every culture's `ui` block (data/families.json) changes: frame (material + colour), panel (the faces: material + colour), button (material + colour), primary (the Start button's face), accent (glows, captions, gold), text and dim (type colours), title (display type), ornament (the crest motif), banner (the cut of a race's banner), metal (studs, rods). `culture_faces`: whether a culture's own panel material and colour replace the direction's (true for timber: every culture brings its own face). Materials: wood, bronze, gold, iron, marble, stone, sandstone, parchment, felt, leather, reed, lacquer, bone. Ornaments: sun, laurel, meander, reeds, rivets, stitch, leaves, crown, bones, lotus, cloud, step, longship. Banners: square, fringe, swallowtail, pointed, notched, tongues, ragged, scalloped.
